notes.title: Patch Update
notes.notes:
A week later and here we are, another patch to help smooth out some issues folks were having. 



 Cleaned up some lightmapping issues on various scenes. (Stretched Black textures on certain objects)
 Did pass on various Typos throughout the game.
 2.5D Scenes where tweaked to allow for better selection of objects.
 Colliders were updated in a few scenes to prevent the player from passing through walls.
 Audio balancing pass, some sounds were reduced such as the car alarm.
 Interaction points were made a bit more accessible for objects in the ending scenes.
 Better Steam Deck and controller improvements.
 General Performance improvements.

Thank you for reporting, always helps, we hope that you keep enjoying the game!

notes.title: Quick Hotfix
notes.notes: Fixed the issue with Conversations blocking the Main Menu, you can now access that correctly during all conversations.

notes.title: Patch Update
notes.notes:
Hello folks, here is a quick patch for a couple issues we had reported to us.



 Fixed several controller bugs, most important being the save menu.
 Fixed aquarium sidewalk visual lightbake.
 Selfie controller with X and not with A.
 Make thoughts stay slightly longer, Dax properly mulls things over.
 localized streamer note
 streamer note now closing properly.
 added additional colliders in aquarium scene, now you cannot swim with the fishes. 
 Dax now uses a proper comparison to Mars gravity.
 Park Cable slightly moved better into scene.


Always appreciating folks pointing out anything you find, this helps us polish the game into an even better state!

notes.title: Post Launch Hotfix
notes.notes:
Hello good folks!

While the team is taking a break from all the work we put into getting the game out, we did quickly fix a couple of smaller issues and typos. 



 Various typos in game text (English)
 Interaction with Snifty in the park was adjusted to be more consistent.
 Steam Deck fixes for various interactions being off due to screen ratio.
 Improved controller support.

After a good weekend rest, we hope to work on some quality of life features to improve the Mars Vice experience, so keep an eye out and thank you to everyone reporting!

notes.title: Demo Patch - 250225
notes.notes:
Bit of a quick patch for some minor bugs and quality of life issues in the demo. Below are key changes.


 Fixed stuttering issue with ending video.
 Fixed video audio not being connected to master audio.
 Re-enabled pause menu at start of game before player collects beeperphone.
 Improved texture compression and performance on low end machines.


Thank you to everyone enjoying the demo and reporting these issues!
